note: Nepal: Indian nationals may cross the open border without passport or visa and live and work in Nepal (the 1950 Treaty of Peace and Friendship), though not own land or work in government institutions. Anyone else is employed on the Department of Labour's work permit, which the employer may seek only where no Nepali citizen can supply the skill, after advertising in a national daily (Labour Act 2074, s. 22). No days without it. The Act is read from a publisher's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, India–Nepal relations
sources.said: The Indo-Nepal border is open; Nepalese and Indian nationals may move freely across the border without passports or visas and may live and work in either country. However, Indians are not allowed to own land-properties or work in government institutions in Nepal,

sources.title: Nepal Laws, Labour Act 2074, Section 22: Restriction on employment of foreigners
sources.said: No employer shall employ any foreign citizen as a labour without obtaining a work permit from the Department.
